name: 外壁・軒裏の規定を修繕時も適用除外に
summary: 条例は、既存不適格建築物に適用する建築基準の範囲を定めています。この議案では、外壁または軒裏に関する規定が適用されない建築物について、一定の大規模な修繕や模様替えを行う場合も、その規定を適用しない扱いにします。
changes: 外壁の規定が適用されない建築物は、外壁以外の部分の大規模な修繕・模様替えで適用除外を続ける
軒裏の規定が適用されない建築物は、屋根と外壁以外の部分の大規模な修繕・模様替えで適用除外を続ける
who: 該当する既存不適格建築物の所有者
why: 建築基準法施行令の一部改正に伴い、該当する既存不適格建築物で大規模な修繕などを行う場合も、外壁や軒裏に関する規定を引き続き適用しない扱いにするためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Exempts exterior wall and eaves soffit rules during repairs as well
en.official: On Enacting an Ordinance to Partially Amend the Kawasaki City Building Standards Ordinance
en.summary: The ordinance sets the scope of building standards that apply to existing non-conforming buildings. This bill provides that, for buildings exempt from provisions concerning exterior walls or eaves soffits, those provisions will also not apply when certain large-scale repairs or alterations are carried out.
changes: Continue exempting buildings from the exterior wall provisions when large-scale repairs or alterations are made to parts other than the exterior walls
Continue exempting buildings from the eaves soffit provisions when large-scale repairs or alterations are made to parts other than the roof and exterior walls
who: Owners of relevant existing non-conforming buildings exempt from the exterior wall provisions
Owners of relevant existing non-conforming buildings exempt from the eaves soffit provisions
en.why: The city says this is to continue treating provisions concerning exterior walls and eaves soffits as not applicable even when relevant existing non-conforming buildings undergo large-scale repairs or similar work, following a partial amendment to the Enforcement Order of the Building Standards Act.
